pin_setup_line: Optional. A 4-digit PIN keeps Advanced settings and the For family page safe from changes by mistake.
pin_mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
pin_enter_line: This part is for family helpers.
pin_wrong: That PIN is not right. Please try again.
pin_forgot_text: This removes the PIN so anyone can open Advanced settings and the For family page. Your call history is not changed. You can set a new PIN in Advanced settings.
set_pin_line_on: On. Advanced settings and For family need the PIN.
family_page_line: Someone you trust. On a scam warning you can call or message them with one tap. Kept only on this phone.
